title: Farol Protocol v0.1 — handshake/hello
description: Request and response envelopes for the handshake/hello method. See protocol/SPEC.md §6 for the normative sequencing and versioning rules. The core sends the request first, right after spawning the plugin process; the plugin MUST respond before accepting any other method. This file also defines WidgetDeclaration, ActionDeclaration, ActionTarget and CapabilityManifest, which are referenced by widget.schema.json and action.schema.json.

RequestId.title: RequestId
RequestId.description: JSON-RPC request id, chosen by the core, unique within a connection while unresolved.

ProtocolVersion.title: ProtocolVersion
ProtocolVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR version string (e.g. "0.1"). See protocol/SPEC.md §6.4 for the comparison algorithm. This version of the schema set describes protocol_version = "0.1".

core_name.description: Identifies the core sending the request (e.g. "farol-core"). Informative only - not used by the compatibility rule.

CapabilityManifest.title: CapabilityManifest
CapabilityManifest.description: Plugin-declared capability manifest. No enforcement is defined by protocol v0.1 - the core only registers and displays what the plugin declares.

capabilities.description: Capability identifiers. The git-local reference plugin declares at least ["exec"].

WidgetDeclaration.title: WidgetDeclaration
WidgetDeclaration.description: Declares one widget offered by the plugin. The list of WidgetDeclaration objects returned in a handshake result is frozen for the lifetime of the connection - it does not change afterwards.

id.description: Stable identifier of this widget within this plugin (e.g. "repo-status"). Used as widget_id in widget/get requests.

kind.description: Declarative widget type (e.g. "status-grid"). Vocabulary is owned by the core, not the plugin - the core uses this value to pick how to render the widget's items. A kind unknown to the core MUST be silently ignored (widget not rendered), without failing the plugin or the core.

title.description: Human-readable label shown by the core (e.g. "Repositórios Git").

suggested_refresh_interval_ms.description: Suggested refresh interval in milliseconds for this widget's widget/get polling cycle. When absent, the core MUST apply a default of 30000ms.

ActionTarget.title: ActionTarget
ActionTarget.description: Identifies the object an action operates on. The core MUST echo this value back verbatim in action/invoke requests, never reconstructing it on its own.

type.description: Target kind. In protocol v0.1 / the git-local reference plugin, always "repo".

id.description: Identifier of the target within its type (e.g. the absolute path of a repository).

ActionDeclaration.title: ActionDeclaration
ActionDeclaration.description: Declares one action offered by the plugin over a specific target, symmetrical to WidgetDeclaration. May be delivered in the handshake result (when already known) and/or in subsequent widget/get responses (see protocol/SPEC.md §6.3.1). The core MUST NOT construct an ActionDeclaration from its own heuristics - only what the plugin explicitly declares is ever exposed to the user.

id.description: Stable action identifier (e.g. "git.fetch"). The same action id is typically reused across many targets - `target` is what differentiates instances.

target.description: The object this specific action instance operates on.

enabled.description: Whether this action is currently invokable, as declared by the plugin. The core MUST NOT decide this on its own and MUST NOT display/allow invoking an action declared with enabled=false.

timeout_hint_ms.description: Plugin-suggested timeout budget, in milliseconds, for RPC_TIMEOUT_ACTION when this specific action is invoked via action/invoke. When absent, the core MUST apply a default of 120000ms.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version spoken by the plugin.

widgets.description: Widgets offered by this plugin. Frozen for the connection's lifetime.

actions.description: Actions already known at handshake time. MAY be empty when the plugin's action list is only knowable after a subsequent widget/get call (see protocol/SPEC.md §6.3.1) - callers MUST treat this list as the actions known so far, not necessarily the definitive/complete set.

HandshakeHelloResponseError.title: HandshakeHelloResponseError
HandshakeHelloResponseError.description: Plugin-side refusal path (protocol/SPEC.md §6.1) - e.g. code -32000 / reason "protocol_version_incompatible" when the plugin itself rejects the core's proposed protocol_version instead of returning a result.
